title: Strict Conditions: Siempre y Cuando and More
goal: Set strict conditions with siempre y cuando and con la condición de que, and keep the subjunctive after every connector that sets terms.

items: I can set a strict condition with siempre y cuando and con la condición de que.
I can keep the subjunctive after all the connectors that set terms.
I can use the new words for deals and agreements.
